items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: he actually took me under his wing... when I played with him I felt like I was in my glory... he had Fletcher Henderson on piano.

ctx.x: Fletcher Henderson. What can you tell me about working with Fletcher?

A very fine gentleman. A wonderful man, a wonderful pianist, and one of the highlights of my career because I knew about his music with Benny Goodman and he actually took me under his wing. He was very nice to me, and very warm and gracious to me. And every time I played with Fletcher Henderson I was thinking about the days that Benny Goodman was playing his music. “King Porter Stomp,” “Wrapping it Up,” “Stealing Apples,” “Dear Old Southland.” And when I played with him I felt like I was in my glory.
